events.naturalDisconnectedReachability: No hardware core exists in the measured map, so no notification producer is installed. Specs alone do not emit actions. Manual runtime send_action or direct core method invocation is outside this profile; emitEvent itself has no connection guard.

sideEffects.guardCaveat: The original guard can open a warning toast once per runtimeId and updates its private warning-deduplication state; these calls are not globally side-effect-free. No hardware methods are reachable after an empty-map guard.

limitations: Direct official domain calls, not native project execution or proof of child-expression evaluation order.
inputs is official args0 value-socket order, not domain getter order; child values must still be evaluated by callers.
Promise scheduling is only the local JS microtask observation. No full native scheduling equivalence claimed.
Connected devices, other hardware families and synthetic runtime events are out of scope.
No Rust implementation or coverage table changes made.
